storyboard.concept: Confident mirror selfie outfit check showcasing premium embroidered lawn suit

scenes.visual: Full-length mirror shot of confident woman holding phone up, wearing complete embroidered green lawn suit, head-to-toe view in modern room
scenes.background: Large wall mirror in tastefully styled modern bedroom, soft natural light streaming from window, warm neutral tones, blurred elegant decor
scenes.vo: Guys, main bilkul obsessed hun is outfit ke saath

scenes.visual: Same woman turns to flattering three-quarter angle in mirror, showing the drape and flow of the embroidered lawn suit, phone still raised
scenes.background: Same mirror setting with soft diffused lighting, modern minimalist room with warm undertones
scenes.vo: Dekho yeh embroidery kitni gorgeous hai, aur fabric ka drape - unreal

scenes.visual: Closer waist-up framing of the woman in mirror, focusing on intricate embroidery details and neckline, holding phone for selfie
scenes.background: Close-up mirror reflection with soft backlighting, blurred warm interior background
scenes.vo: Is embroidered work ko dekho - premium quality hai bilkul

scenes.visual: Woman looks confidently at camera through mirror while holding phone, showing complete styled look with dupatta
scenes.background: Full mirror view with elegant room setting, soft window light creating dreamy atmosphere
scenes.vo: Perfect hai meri Eid ki shopping ke liye

scenes.visual: Final confident pose in mirror, woman smiling at camera while holding phone, complete outfit visible
scenes.background: Bright mirror setting with optimistic lighting, clean modern aesthetic
scenes.vo: Tumko bhi chahiye? The Collection se shop karo abhi - link description mein hai

storyboard.notes: Mirror selfie format captures authentic social media aesthetic while showcasing the premium embroidered lawn suit. Each scene builds confidence and desire through personal testimonial style voiceover in natural Hinglish, ending with clear shopping direction.
